raw_request_summary: CF-023: the protocol state-contradiction check treats a gate as approved from a signature-valid trusted receipt without comparing the receipt artifact_ref and artifact_sha256 against the current gate-host note, so a gate approved against one checkout of a note reads as approved against a different version of that same note elsewhere in the repository.
